Subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart, endpoints & rate limits

Hi Samira / Michael —

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and really appreciate the context on the POC goals (secure PHI redaction and real-time summarization for triage). Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

1) Recommended starting deployment: Hosted API (fastest to spin up, no infra to manage) — good fit for the POC to validate function and UX.
2) If you need predictable, sustained throughput or strict data residency/managed infra, we can scope Dedicated capacity or Private (VPC/on-prem) later. I noted you mentioned potential peaks ~500 RPS; that influences capacity sizing.

Quickstart & sandbox access:
- I've attached a brief quickstart (redwood-quickstart.md) with example curl/SDK calls.
- Sandbox keys: you can use the trial API key from the Console to test endpoints. I can also create a short-lived sandbox key scoped to your account if you prefer.

Endpoints & rate limits (Hosted API):
- REST endpoint (generation): https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
- Embeddings endpoint: https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings
- Default trial rate limit: 60 RPS per API key, burst to 120 RPS for short periods.
- Production Hosted tiers: configurable up to ~2000 RPS (by contract). For sustained >2000 RPS we typically recommend Dedicated.

Data & compliance:
- Hosted encrypts data at rest and in transit. For regulated workflows (PHI), we can discuss Private deployments or Dedicated with customer-managed keys.

Action items / next steps:
- Could you confirm whether you want us to provision a scoped sandbox API key?
- Please share expected peak RPS and typical request size (avg tokens per request) so we can estimate cost and advise hosted vs dedicated.
- If helpful, we can schedule a short security & architecture call with our infra/security lead (Rishi) this week.

Attaching: redwood-quickstart.md and a short rate limits cheat sheet.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications before we dive into the sandbox: 

1) Trial quotas: how many tokens / requests are included in the trial sandbox? We want to validate high-throughput ingest and a few real-time flows.
2) IP allowlist & network controls: can we restrict API access to our VPC or a set of static IPs during evaluation?
3) Rate limits: you mentioned default 60 RPS trial and prod up to ~2000 RPS. For our POC we expect short bursts to ~500 RPS and sustained periods around 200–300 RPS. Can Hosted support that without Dedicated?
4) Compliance: do you have SOC 2 Type II and a data-residency option for US-only storage?

We're leaning Hosted for the initial POC to move quickly, but we need a clear path to Dedicated/Private if the performance and compliance demands require it. Also — could you share a rough monthly cost estimate for the Hosted usage above (ballpark)?

If you and Rishi are available, let's set the security call for Wed afternoon PT.

—Samira

Hi Samira — thanks for the questions, great points. Answers below and a proposed plan: 

1) Trial quotas: the sandbox comes with 100k tokens/day by default and no hard request cap besides the RPS limits. If you need a larger trial quota I can increase it temporarily.

2) Network controls: Hosted API supports IP allowlists per API key and we can configure inbound restrictions for your account. For strict VPC-only access, Private deployment is required; Dedicated can also be fronted by your preferred network setup with partner networking options.

3) Rate limits: for trials we start at 60 RPS; we can bump to 200 RPS on request for short-term evals. Hosted production tiers are negotiable and can support sustained 500 RPS — often we scope this on contract with autoscaling policies. For sustained multi-hundred RPS with guaranteed latency, Dedicated is the safer long-term option.

4) Compliance: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II. For US-only data residency we can discuss Dedicated with region-restricted storage or a Private deployment. I'll share our SOC 2 attestation in the security call.

Ballpark cost: based on your stated patterns (200–500 RPS, mid-sized request payloads ~1k tokens/request), I'd estimate Hosted would run about $6–12k/month for a POC (cold estimate; will fine-tune with exact token counts and retention). Dedicated pricing starts with a monthly reserved capacity commitment — I can pull numbers if you want an estimate.

Proposed next steps:
- I can provision a scoped sandbox API key for BrightWell today (y/n?).
- Security & architecture sync: Wed 18 Mar 2026 at 14:00 PT — does that work? Rishi will cover SOC2, network controls, and KMS options.
- I'll upload the SOC 2 attestation and a short SOW draft to the HubSpot record and share a DocuSign link if you want a quick MSA addendum later.

If you confirm sandbox key + Wed slot, I'll action both.

Best,
Marissa
